lines.title: Starting budget
lines.approvedBy: the author, 2026-10-25 ("decide for me"; Meta decided $100)

intake.name: Hani's Blog
intake.purpose: Writing worth rereading on machine learning, product and leadership, in English and Arabic, with interactive demos that let the reader test the idea
intake.product: bilingual posts (EN/AR), the book The Dream, interactive demos, content sparks
intake.measure: published bilingual posts that pass the site's checks (typecheck, lint, build, Playwright) and the editor's review

design: system3-meta docs/proposals/2026-10-25-blog-org.md (design 1: an editorial desk around the author)

newRoles.title: Developmental editor
newRoles.mission: The argument of each post and book chapter: structure, what it claims and whether it holds; documents substantive edits for the author's review.

newRoles.title: Line editor
newRoles.mission: The sentences, in the author's voice (writing-style): proposes edits, never rewrites the baseline without the author's yes.

newRoles.title: Arabic editor
newRoles.mission: The Arabic edition: mature conversational Levantine in the author's voice (translate-post), parity with the English, translationOf links.

newRoles.title: Spark curator
newRoles.mission: Sparks from published posts (extract-spark), in both languages, released in batches with the author's go.

newRoles.title: Demo designer
newRoles.mission: What a demo must teach: learning test cases first (edu-demo-test-cases, the decision-lab pedagogy).

newRoles.title: Demo builder
newRoles.mission: Self-contained demo bundles that pass their test cases (edu-demo-builder).

newRoles.title: Demo evaluator
newRoles.mission: Judges demos in the browser on their test cases, artifact before account (edu-demo-evaluator); never judges its own work.
